capability_classes.description: Deployment-declared legged mobility and original visual condition observation. Loaded class and exact support are independently checked before registration. The local observation.verify@v1 profile accepts expected=detected(entity-ref) for an admitted object identity and reads the existing visual observation. A false observation completes acquisition only; it does not establish the condition or move the observer. Active acquisition is a separate bounded approach-and-sense capability for the exact entity; cached verify never moves. Navigation completion alone does not establish detection. Camera FOV and gimbal limits are not declared and remain unknown.
